technical.summary: Strong bullish structure (golden cross, three white soldiers, price above all major MAs) but severely overbought on short-term oscillators with weak trend strength; suitable for swing entry only with tight stops or on pullback confirmation.

fundamental.summary: WAB shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 68 days—insufficient smart money conviction to support a trade.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (25/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is stale (315+ days old) with no recent conviction signals, and absent news data limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (375.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 68 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Golden cross + three white soldiers + price above major MAs form textbook bullish structure, and extreme market fear (VIX 375.2) creates contrarian buy opportunity for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme overbought conditions (RSI 72.28, Stoch K 95.03, Williams %R overbought), weak ADX trend strength (15.42), 15x volume spike exhaustion risk, zero fundamental conviction, and unfavorable macro environment make entry now high-risk without pullback confirmation.

decision.entry_rationale: Golden cross and three white soldiers provide bullish structure, but extreme overbought conditions (RSI 72.28, Stoch K 95.03) combined with weak ADX (15.42) and 15x volume spike exhaustion risk demand pullback confirmation before entry.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis regime (375.2) and overbought oscillators create high probability of sharp mean-reversion pullback that could trigger stop-loss before swing target is reached.
